summary: Site Settings (General Settings) feature testing complete. All 12 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified: Admin settings page at /dev/settings loads correctly with Site Settings, Contact Settings, and System Settings sections. Maintenance mode toggle works - when enabled, non-authenticated users see MaintenancePage while admins can still access the site. Dynamic logo displayed in FloatingNav and Footer. Document title updates from site_name setting.
critical_code_review_comments: Site settings feature well-implemented with proper separation between admin and public endpoints
MaintenanceGuard correctly checks user role (admin/super_admin) before bypassing maintenance mode
SiteSettingsProvider in App.js properly fetches settings and updates document title/favicon dynamically
FloatingNav and Footer components fetch logo from /api/settings/site correctly
Toggle switches for maintenance_mode and debug_mode auto-save when clicked
seed_data_creation: Site settings modified during testing but restored to original values
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site Settings feature fully tested. Admin page at /dev/settings shows General Settings with 3 sections: Site Settings (site_name, logo_url, favicon_url), Contact Settings (admin_email, support_email), and System Settings (maintenance_mode, debug_mode toggles). Public API at /api/settings/site returns logo, favicon, maintenance_mode, debug_mode. MaintenancePage shows wrench icon with 'We'll Be Back Soon' message when maintenance_mode is enabled for non-auth users.

Backend API Tests (12 passed).GET /api/settings/site (public): PASS - Returns site settings without auth
Backend API Tests (12 passed).GET /api/admin-settings/site: PASS - Returns full admin settings with auth
Backend API Tests (12 passed).PUT /api/admin-settings/site - site_name: PASS - Updates site name and persists
Backend API Tests (12 passed).PUT /api/admin-settings/site - logo_url: PASS - Updates logo URL and persists
Backend API Tests (12 passed).PUT /api/admin-settings/site - favicon_u: PASS - Updates favicon URL and persists
Backend API Tests (12 passed).Settings persistence test: PASS - All fields persist across requests
Backend API Tests (12 passed).Admin access during maintenance: PASS - Admin can access settings endpoint

Frontend UI Tests.Footer displays dynamic logo: PASS - Footer uses logo_url from settings
Frontend UI Tests.Site Settings section: PASS - Shows site_name, site_url, logo_url, favicon_url fields
Frontend UI Tests.System Settings section: PASS - Shows Maintenance Mode and Debug Mode toggles
Frontend UI Tests.Edit mode functionality: PASS - Edit button enables editing, Save/Cancel buttons appear
Frontend UI Tests.Maintenance Mode toggle: PASS - Auto-saves when toggled, shows warning when enabled
Frontend UI Tests.Maintenance Page displayed: PASS - Non-auth users see MaintenancePage when enabled
Frontend UI Tests.Admin bypass maintenance: PASS - Logged-in admins can access site during maintenance

verified_features: General Settings admin page loads correctly at /dev/settings
Saving site settings (site_name, logo_url, favicon_url) via admin panel
Public API endpoint /api/settings/site returns correct values
FloatingNav component displays dynamic logo from settings
Footer component displays dynamic logo from settings
Maintenance Mode toggle saves correctly and auto-saves on change
Debug Mode toggle saves correctly and auto-saves on change
